title: Hazel and the Giggly Rhyme Show
moral: You shine the brightest when you are just being you.
description: It's Talent Show night in Clover Wood! Pip can juggle (sort of), Tumble can honk, but shy little Hazel thinks she has no talent at all. Learn rhyming words like frog and log, bee and tree, and cat and hat in this funny animated story about being yourself, for kids aged 3 to 8.

Rhymes are words that sound the same at the end. Like cat and hat!

narration.text: So Hazel tried to honk like Tumble.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Easy! Watch me! HOOOONK!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Meep!
Meep! A teeny, tiny meep! Then she tried to hoot like Nana Hoot.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Hoo... hoo... hiccup!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Little one, you don't need a honk. What do YOU love to do? I think... snoooore...
Nana's glasses slipped down her beak. Then she jumped!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! Go on, dear. Show me what you love.

narration.text: So Hazel took her friends to the pond for her favourite game. The Rhyme Game!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I see a frog on a... what rhymes with frog?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! Ooh! I know! BANANA!
Banana? Silly Pip! Look at the pond, friends. What is the frog sitting on? Can you say it?
Log! Frog and log! You're so smart!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Then what rhymes with bee? BANANA!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Pip, that's two bananas!

narration.text: That evening, everybody in Clover Wood sat down for the show.
Pip juggled. Bonk! Tumble took a big breath to sing... and his trunk began to tickle.
Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
Down came the big red curtain! Swoosh, flop! Right on top of Pip and Tumble!
Look! Two wiggly lumps, one fluffy tail and a honking trunk! HONK! HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Oh my! Who will keep everybody happy while we untangle them?

narration.text: Everybody was waiting. Tap, tap, tap! Hazel's prickles went BOING!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Me? But I can't juggle. I can't honk. I can only meep!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: You don't need to be Pip. You don't need to be Tumble. Just be Hazel.
Hazel took one slow breath. Then she walked out, step, step, step.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I don't need to be anyone new. It's fun to just be me... and you!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Now that's a rhyme! I think... snoooore... I'm awake!
And Hazel's tiny meep was the happiest sound in all of Clover Wood.
